_comment: Copy to config.json (repo root) and edit. config.json is gitignored — keep secrets out of version control. Per-tool settings live under the tool's key (its skills/ directory name), not at the top level. Every key is optional and overridable by the matching LIBBOT_<KEY> env var (e.g. LIBBOT_CATALOG_BASE). Precedence: built-in defaults < this file < LIBBOT_* env. Point LIBBOT_CONFIG at this file to keep it elsewhere; choose the interpreter with LIBBOT_PYTHON (default: the repo's .venv).

catalog-search._inline_enrichers_note: Enrichers that run eagerly on every --annotate search — the two defaults are the cheap, always-on inline probes. HathiTrust (--htrc), PubMed (--pubmed), and public full-text discovery (findtext.py) are opt-in / on-demand, not listed here. See skills/catalog-search/SKILL.md for the full set.
